RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of discrimination; composition usually reflects availability and internal roles. 

The appointed candidate is qualified: she is chartered, has eight years of experience, and brings strong client relationship skills, which are often decisive for a commercial leadership role over technical tenure alone.

Raising the panel's gender without hard evidence of bias will appear unprofessional, damage your reputation, and burn industry bridges without changing the outcome. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up inquiring about constructive interview feedback. Frame your inquiry around professional growth and leadership development, focusing strictly on your performance rather than panel demographics.
